classified_blocking_hard_checks.skip_risk: high -- empirically skips in nearly every non-full-portfolio run (GOV-014, plans/backlog-post-poc.md:362-379)
classified_blocking_hard_checks.why_currently_ungated: family/platform are supplied only when a selected aspose.* fact's source.location starts with 'data/imported:' (aspose_checks_bridge.py::_real_kwargs). Neither gate treats a classified-blocking SKIP as a failure -- local_poc_acceptance_binding.py's validate_acceptance_artifact_chain gates only on outcome=='error' by deliberate design (907ac0847 commit message: gating on skip broke 36+ unrelated tests); validate_readme_document_candidate never inspects skip/error state at all.
classified_blocking_hard_checks.generic_existing_source_identified: data/products.json (the 33-repository registry) carries 'family' and 'platform' for every registered repository deterministically at load time, keyed by repo_url/org_repo -- independent of whether any Aspose knowledge fact was imported, selected, or survived verification. This is NOT currently threaded into run_aspose_checks()/_real_kwargs(); GOV-014's own text independently proposes the same fix direction ('derive family/platform from a broader real source e.g. the run's own org_repo/registry entry').
